programmes.name_en: Badir Program for Technology Incubators and Accelerators
programmes.funder: Badir, King Abdulaziz City for Science and Technology (KACST)
programmes.amount_note: Incubation and acceleration services (workspace, technical labs, mentoring, investor access) rather than direct cash. Badir connects graduates to KACST and NTDP funding instruments.
programmes.deadline_note: Applications accepted on a rolling basis into ICT, biotech, advanced manufacturing and other vertical incubators, with periodic cohort intakes.

procedure_steps.detail: Apply through the Badir portal choosing the relevant incubator.
Screening and technical assessment.
Interview and admission.
Incubation with milestone reviews.

eligibility.other_note: Focused on Saudi-based technology entrepreneurs; some tracks accept pre-incorporation teams.

programmes.name_local: برنامج كفالة تمويل المنشآت الصغيرة والمتوسطة
programmes.funder: Kafalah Program (SME Bank / Ministry of Finance and Saudi banks)
programmes.amount_note: Guarantees a share (commonly up to 80-90% for startups) of bank financing to Saudi SMEs, with guaranteed amounts historically up to about SAR 15 million per enterprise. Kafalah does not lend directly.
programmes.deadline_note: Rolling; applications are made through a participating bank or finance company.

procedure_steps.detail: Approach a participating bank for financing.
The bank submits a Kafalah guarantee request.
Kafalah assesses and issues the guarantee.
Bank disburses the facility.

eligibility.other_note: Saudi-registered SMEs within Monsha'at size thresholds; startups can qualify with higher guarantee coverage.

programmes.amount_note: Zero enrolment cost, fully sponsored by Misk Foundation: 10-week hybrid pre-acceleration programme with mentorship and workshops; investment-readiness support may be extended to top startups. No equity or cash stated on the page.
programmes.deadline_note: Misk Launchpad 10.0 applications ran 15 June to 8 August 2026 and are closed (program 6 Sep 2026 - 2 Jan 2027). Use Notify Me for the next cohort.
programmes.reopen_note: Misk has run its accelerator through changing partner operators; between editions, founders are directed to Misk's broader entrepreneurship and skills programmes.

procedure_steps.detail: Check misk.org.sa for the open cohort.
Apply online.
Screening and interviews.
Cohort participation and demo day.

eligibility.other_note: Early-stage tech or tech-enabled startups (idea, prototype, MVP or early-launch). Saudi national or non-Saudi committed to testing and launching in Saudi Arabia; solo founders eligible; programme in English.

programmes.source_snippet: Misk Launchpad is a pre-acceleration program designed for entrepreneurs in the ideation stage for building their tech startups.

programmes.name_local: طموح - الهيئة العامة للمنشآت الصغيرة والمتوسطة
programmes.funder: Small and Medium Enterprises General Authority (Monsha'at)
programmes.amount_note: Tomoh is a capability and market-access programme for high-growth Saudi enterprises rather than a cash grant. Monsha'at separately runs indirect lending, the Kafalah guarantee and matchmaking with funds.
programmes.deadline_note: Cohort-based with application windows announced on monshaat.gov.sa.
programmes.reopen_note: Monsha'at refreshes its programme catalogue each year under Vision 2030 targets; new cohorts are announced on the authority's portal and social channels.

procedure_steps.detail: Register on the Monsha'at portal.
Apply to the Tomoh cohort during an open window.
Assessment of growth potential.
Enrolment in the acceleration track.

eligibility.other_note: The enterprise must be Saudi; owner must have an active Absher account; enterprise must be small or medium-sized per Monsha'at definition; financial data must be provided. Process: registration and submission, analysis and identification, utilisation of services.

programmes.source_snippet: The enterprise must be Saudi ... The enterprise must be small or medium-sized according to the definition of Monsha'at

programmes.amount_note: Financing up to SAR 8.5 million for medium tech companies, SAR 5 million for small and SAR 2 million for micro tech companies (Monsha'at revenue classification); financing period up to 5 years including grace period of up to 6 months. Delivered with the Saudi Development Bank (SDB).
programmes.deadline_note: Rolling applications through the NTDP portal and participating financial institutions.

procedure_steps.detail: Register the company on the NTDP portal.
Apply to the relevant financing product.
Credit assessment by NTDP and/or the partner lender.
Facility issued.

eligibility.other_note: Micro, small and medium information technology companies registered in Saudi Arabia.

programmes.source_snippet: Up to SAR 8.5 million for medium tech companies. Up to SAR 5 million for small tech companies. Up to SAR 2 million for micro tech companies.

programmes.name_local: مختبر النموذج الأولي - برنامج تنمية القدرات البشرية التقنية
programmes.amount_note: Financial grant of up to SAR 150,000 plus workspace, mentorship, workshops, consultations and Demo Day, for entrepreneurs who have completed the MVP stage or have a feasibility study.
programmes.deadline_note: Cohort-based intakes announced on the NTDP portal and through partner accelerators.
programmes.reopen_note: NTDP publishes its product catalogue and open windows on ntdp.gov.sa; MVPLab intakes are delivered with rotating entrepreneurship partners.

procedure_steps.detail: Register on the NTDP portal.
Apply to MVPLab during an open cohort.
Technical and commercial screening.
Build the MVP with partner support and milestone funding.

eligibility.other_note: Aimed at Saudi-based technology founders at idea and prototype stage.

programmes.source_snippet: providing financial support through grants of up to 150,000 SAR, in addition to other services such as workspace, mentorship, and training.

programmes.name_en: NTDP Relocate (international startup relocation to Saudi Arabia)
programmes.amount_note: Package of licensing support, soft-landing services and incentives for international technology companies establishing a regional headquarters or entity in Saudi Arabia. Cash component is negotiated per company.
programmes.deadline_note: Rolling; delivered with the Ministry of Investment and Monsha'at.

procedure_steps.detail: Apply through the NTDP portal or an NTDP partner.
Assessment of the company's fit with Saudi technology priorities.
Incentive package agreed.
Entity established and incentives released against milestones.

eligibility.other_note: For international technology companies committing to a Saudi entity and local hiring.

programmes.name_en: Saudi Venture Capital (SVC) fund and direct investment programmes
programmes.funder: Saudi Venture Capital Company (SVC), a subsidiary of the SME Bank / National Development Fund
programmes.amount_note: SVC is a fund-of-funds and co-investor with over SAR 6 billion committed. It invests into venture funds and, through its direct investment programme, alongside lead investors into Saudi startups. Cheque sizes are not published; SVC does not fund companies that have no lead investor.
programmes.deadline_note: Rolling; SVC follows the timetable of the lead investor's round.

procedure_steps.detail: Raise a round with a qualified lead investor.
The lead or the company approaches SVC for co-investment.
Due diligence.
Co-investment on the lead's terms.

documents_required.doc: Term sheet from the lead investor

eligibility.other_note: Companies must be Saudi-incorporated or have a substantive Saudi presence; SVC only invests alongside private lead investors.
